input.quote: 12.22 Notwithstanding any other provisions in this Paragraph 12, when the Equipped Capacity is expanded to six (6) times of Initial Equipped Capacity or three (3) years after the RFS date whichever comes first, any Party is entitled to make available any of its Allocated Capacity for use by other Carriers on any commercial basis without any restrictions.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restraint binding us. Searches for "compete", "shall not", "restriction(s)", "exclusive", resale/field-of-use and territory language surfaced only (i) "competent tribunal/jurisdiction" references (p0272, p0275), (ii) the sole-and-exclusive dispute remedy in p0262, and (iii) the capacity provisions in Paragraph 12, which are affirmatively permissive: Subparagraphs 12.20 and 12.22 entitle any Party to sell IRUs or make Allocated Capacity available to other Carriers "without any restrictions". Subparagraph 17.4 is likewise pro-competitive, binding Terminal Parties not to impede qualified Carriers' Direct Access. These provisions benefit us and are not flagged. The clause therefore satisfies the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer); no redline is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
